title: Pass ACP session workspaces into GAWD missions
goal: Ensure a GAWD-backed ACP turn runs against the validated workspace selected when the ACP session was opened, while preserving the existing test runner seam and confinement checks.

results.change: GawdAcpExecutor now uses a workspace-aware production mission runner and passes the ACP session workspace through; the legacy with_runner test seam remains unchanged.
results.focused: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-gawd-a2a --lib: 56 passed, 0 failed, including the workspace propagation regression
results.lean_core_ceilings: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test lean_core_ceilings: 2 passed, 0 failed; susi-gawd-a2a 3347/3347 shipped Rust lines
results.full_gate: cargo local-workflow check: fmt and clippy passed; 145 test binaries built; concurrent suite failed once in host_only_privacy and once in peer_channel_hub. Isolated reruns passed: host_only_privacy 2/2 in 11.86s; peer_channel_hub 2/2 in 18.92s. The changed crate and ceiling guard are green.
results.boundary: Core ACP-to-GAWD workspace propagation only; no cancellation, protocol, Commercial, dependency, Minijinja, release, or credential change
